analyst_view.overall: Toulouse are 12th with 14 points and earned a 1-1 draw at Lens last Saturday behind a sharp Guillaume Restes in goal and a compact defence; a win would lift them above Rennes. Rennes are 9th with 17 points but without a win in four (1-1 at Lorient, 1-2 v Lille, 5-2 at Nice), and Franck Haise is under pressure: L'Equipe, as reported by But! Football Club, says his future could be discussed if the next two games go badly, and Pierre Sage's name is circulating, though nothing is decided. Rennes play at NEC Nijmegen in the Europa League on Thursday at 21:00, so they have under three days and a trip before this 17:15 Sunday kick-off. Thomasson (suspended) and Frankowski are already taken off by the numbers; Valentin Rongier hurt his thigh at Lorient and is listed out for Nijmegen, which the numbers do not know. Referee Guillaume Paradis (4.0 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, Toulouse 1.7 and Rennes 1.2, already taking off Thomasson and Frankowski (about -14% for Rennes). I lean slightly lower to about 2.8: Rennes come in tired from a Thursday-night game in the Netherlands, lack confidence (Haise says they play without spontaneity) and are also missing midfielder Rongier, while Toulouse defended deep and well at Lens.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 5.0 for Toulouse and 4.4 for Rennes, already lowering Rennes for their recent counts. Toulouse were happy to sit back at Lens (5 corners to 9) but are at home here, and nothing on lineups or style points either way, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, with referee Paradis (4.0 a game) adding about 4% and Toulouse's busy recent card count adding a little. A Rennes side under pressure could get edgy if behind, but that is a hunch, so I stay at about 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.5 shots, already lowering Toulouse for their recent output (61 shots in 6, they had 9 at Lens). Rennes' fatigue could cut their own shots but give Toulouse more room at home, so the two roughly cancel and I stay at about 25.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target, Toulouse 5.0 and Rennes 3.9, already lowering Rennes because Toulouse have allowed few on target lately (20 in 6). Rennes' attack is expected to be Lepaul and Dia as in Europe, which the numbers know, so I stay at about 8.8.
